# Pren: startup accounting

Source: https://usepren.com/

> Pren is an accounting service for startups. Expert AI agents keep your books, prepare your business taxes, run payroll, bills and invoices, and build your cash forecasts. A small professional team handles qualified judgment and review. Plans start at $299 per month.

## The easiest way to do startup accounting

Books, taxes and payroll. Automated by expert AI agents. More time to build, sell and hire.

Pren does the accounting so founders can run the company. Receipts, spreadsheets and deadlines compete with the company you are building; Pren connects your records once and takes over. AI agents handle the work, you see progress and approve the decisions that need you, and accountants review.

## Plans and pricing

- **Pren** (Pre-seed & seed): $299 per month. Books & business taxes. Monthly books and agreed business-tax filings. Includes: 12 monthly closes per year; Up to 5 financial accounts; 500 imported entries per month; Business tax preparation & filing; Reviewed financial statements; Answers, records & exports.
- **Pren Plus** (Series A): $799 per month. Accounting, payroll & planning. Payroll and planning, connected to your books. Includes: Payroll for up to 10 California workers; 20 new bills + 20 new invoices per month; Budgets & a 13-week cash forecast; A 24-month financial forecast; Hiring & spending scenarios; Quarterly board reports & fundraising prep.
- **Custom** (Growth & beyond): custom pricing. A plan for your company. More people, entities or specialist work. Includes: Services chosen for your company; Additional companies, states & countries; More transactions & specialist work; Agreed services, price & delivery dates.

Necessary ledger software is included. Payroll-provider fees, banking and processing charges, government amounts, applicable taxes, and fixed cleanup work are disclosed separately before acceptance.

## Monthly bookkeeping, reviewed

Page: https://usepren.com/services/accounting/
Included in Pren and Pren Plus.

AI-prepared books and financial statements, professionally reviewed. Transactions, supporting records and corrections stay together, so your books reflect the company you are building.

### Monthly books

- Connect up to five financial accounts. Include up to 500 imported entries per month.
- Receive a reviewed monthly close and financial statements for each covered month.
- Find the transaction, supporting record and any correction together.
- Export your books and supporting records whenever you need them.

### Monthly financial reports

- What you earned, what you spent and where cash went.
- See the date of your numbers and anything still being resolved.
- Download your reports and move providers with your records intact.

### Answers about your finances

- Ask about spending, revenue or cash. Get answers from your records.
- Inspect the source records and calculations behind an answer.
- See what is known and what still needs clarification.

## Business tax preparation and filing

Page: https://usepren.com/services/taxes/
Included in Pren and Pren Plus.

Agreed returns prepared, reviewed and followed through filing. Your books and supporting records stay together all year, so tax season starts from reviewed numbers.

### What is included

- Know the company, covered tax year, federal and state returns, and other included filings before you sign.
- Qualified professional review and required signatures come before submission through an authorized filing route.
- See whether a return was accepted or rejected. Pren keeps responsibility for agreed corrections and follow-up.
- Additional jurisdictions, historical years, or specialist work are assessed separately.

## Payroll, bills and customer invoices

Page: https://usepren.com/services/payroll/
Included in Pren Plus.

Pay your team, handle bills and follow up on invoices. Payroll and payments stay connected to your books, and you approve what needs you.

### What is included

- Supported payroll for up to ten California workers.
- Up to 20 new bills or reimbursement cases and 20 new customer invoice cases per month.
- Approve required payments and see whether the money actually arrived.
- Provider fees and other external charges are disclosed before acceptance.

## Budget and cash forecasts

Page: https://usepren.com/services/cash-planning/
Included in Pren Plus.

See how long cash lasts and what you can spend. Forecasts start from reviewed company records, show their assumptions and get a monthly check.

### Budgets and forecasts

- An annual budget and rolling 24-month operating forecast.
- A 13-week cash forecast and scenario comparisons.
- A monthly explanation of what changed against your budget, without a required meeting.
- Forecasts start from reviewed company records and show their assumptions.

### Test a hire or spending decision

- Compare the cash impact before you commit.
- Inspect the assumptions, source dates, and cash effects.
- Compare scenarios against the same company baseline.
- Forecasts are estimates, not guarantees. A scenario does not authorize a hire, payment, or payroll change.

## Board and fundraising reports

Page: https://usepren.com/services/fundraising-readiness/
Included in Pren Plus.

Organized financials for board meetings and fundraising, prepared from the same reviewed books as everything else in Pren.

### What is included

- One standard quarterly board package.
- One standard annual financing-readiness package.
- Choose who can access each shared report.
- Fundraising execution, investor access, and specialist transactions are separate work.

## Getting started

1. **Tell us about your company.** Share your structure, team size and accounting needs. Catch-up work is identified upfront.
2. **Review your plan.** Check the included work, full price and first delivery. Cleanup and provider fees are explained before you accept.
3. **Connect your accounts.** Link your financial records so Pren can start the agreed work. Pren prepares. You approve. Accountants review.

## Questions about Pren

### Is this software or an accounting service?

Pren is an accounting service powered by expert AI agents. They connect your records, prepare the work and follow up on what is still open. A small professional team handles qualified judgment and review. You make the business decisions and give required approvals.

### Can I switch from my current provider?

We review your records, explain any cleanup needed, and agree on a handover before starting. You see the price and timing first.

### How do you get my company ready for tax filing?

Your books and supporting records stay together throughout the year. The tax workflow includes professional review, required signatures and an authorized filing route. We track acceptance or rejection and keep follow-up open until it is resolved. The exact filings and responsibilities are agreed before service starts.

### Which taxes are included?

We confirm the company, tax year and specific filings before you sign. Extra states, countries or past tax years may need a separate price.

### What happens as we grow?

When you hire more people, add a company or expand into another country, we review the extra work and agree the price with you. Your records stay together.

### Are there costs outside the subscription?

Necessary ledger software is included. Payroll-provider fees, banking and processing charges, government amounts, applicable taxes, and fixed cleanup work are disclosed separately before acceptance.

### Am I signing an annual contract?

Plans are monthly. Before you sign, we explain which annual tax work is covered and what happens to your work and records if you leave.
